title: Nell and the Windy Day
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 1 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ay, ou, ie
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5, 79-sound stage (ay, ou, ie just added).

pages.illustration: Leaves streaming sideways across the garden on a bright windy day.

pages.text: Nell wants to play with Pip.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee setting off across the garden towards Pip's tree.
Nell the bee flying high above the hedge, wings working hard.

pages.text: The wind sends Nell off track.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee being blown sideways off course by a gust of wind.

pages.text: Nell can not stay on track.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee tumbling slightly in the air, unable to fly straight.

pages.text: Near the ground, the wind is not so strong.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying low, just above the grass, out of the worst of the wind.

pages.text: Near the ground, Nell can stay on track.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying steadily along close to the grass.

pages.text: Nell gets to Pip at last.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing on the branch beside Pip the sparrow.

pages.text: Pip and Nell play all day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee playing together on a low branch.

pages.text: Pip and Nell play on, out of the wind.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee playing together in a sheltered spot beneath the hedge.
